sources.title: Afghanistan travel recommendations
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores, Unión Europea y Cooperación
sources.officialityEvidence: Spain's live Foreign Ministry country guidance was last updated 24 April 2026 and directly addresses entry documentation for Spanish travellers to Afghanistan.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Para entrar en Afganistán se requiere visado. No es posible obtener visado en frontera.

sources.title: Iran travel recommendations
sources.publisher: Embassy of Spain in Tehran, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: Spain's Embassy in Tehran publishes live MAEC travel guidance, last updated 13 April 2026, for Spanish nationals travelling to Iran.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Irán dejó de expedir visados en frontera ... se requiere realizar una presolicitud en su web

sources.title: North Korea travel recommendations
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores, Unión Europea y Cooperación
sources.officialityEvidence: Spain's live Foreign Ministry country guidance was last updated 6 May 2026 and directly states the documentary and route conditions for Spanish travellers to DPRK.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Se necesita visado, ya sea por turismo o negocios.

unresolved.reason: Current MAEC guidance says a visa is required and unavailable at the border, but it does not establish a current ordinary Spanish tourist issuance channel; fallback advance-visa status is not promoted.
MAEC says border visas have not officially resumed and requires pre-application before travel, but does not establish whether the ordinary Spanish tourist visa is electronically or mission-issued.
MAEC says a tourist visa is required and tourist travel must be through official agencies, but does not establish the ordinary Spanish visitor issuance channel or operational availability.
